instruction.notes: AGENTS.md is read from the project root and, for user-level defaults, from ~/.codex/AGENTS.md.

skills.notes: Skill roots in the current source: the project config folder's skills dir (.codex/skills, repo scope), .agents/skills in every directory between the project root and the cwd, ~/.agents/skills (user), $CODEX_HOME/skills (user, marked deprecated in the source but still read), plus system/admin roots. Project roots are only used when the repository filesystem is available to the session.

quirks: .agents/skills/ is the interoperable project directory: Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and Copilot all read it, so one checked-in folder serves four harnesses.
AGENTS.md is still the most portable instruction surface — Copilot, Cursor and OpenCode read it too. Use it for the loader paragraph and let the skill directory carry the files.
